name: pmrem-hdr-equirect
adaptedFrom: original — what HDRLoader hands three for Midway's sky: a 64x32 HalfFloatType RGBA DataTexture (linear, a sun patch at 24, far above 1) with HDRLoader's settings (flipY, linear filters, no mipmaps) and EquirectangularReflectionMapping as scene.background and scene.environment, PMREM-filtered onto a smooth and a rough metal sphere. parseHDR's decode is proved texel for texel against three's HDRLoader in addons.spec.ts
